uncertain: Domicile descent, eastern city junctions and Hall of Crafting ramp are abstracted; their exact turns and vertical stacking remain unverified.
Vault markers show encounter locations within a room, not measured coffer or NPC coordinates.
Fineous patrols the Hall of Crafting route; marker 9 is approximate.
The highway gate is schematic and state-dependent. Lava swimming routes are omitted because the safe take-off, landing and intermediate ledges were not verified.
notes: Schematic connectivity, not to scale. Dashed corridor edges indicate unverified bends, widths or local stair geometry; endpoints follow the documented connections.
Letters identify paired transitions. E marks an instance entrance; no exterior dungeon rooms are included.
G descends from the crafting halls to the anvil. The small unlabelled rectangle beside boss 10 represents Black Anvil, not Black Forge.
Operating Shadowforge Lock enables F on sheet 01 but blocks the highway route from D to the anvil. The eastern route through C and G remains available.
Watchman Doomgrip appears after the coffer event. Dark Keeper spawn selection varies; no invented fixed keeper position is drawn.
Return to Q4 after obtaining Ironfel.
